articles.body: PARK CITY, Utah — Cost-of-living concerns fueled Democrats to victory this month. Now they’re preparing to do something about it. As newly elected governors gathered for a job training conference hosted by the National Governors Association, conversations among the Democrat-heavy group often turned to the economic woes in their states — and the necessity to get something done quickly. “What are the things that we can do — not in the first 100 days, but in the first 100 hours — that can start bringing some relief to the American people?” Wes Moore, the National Governors Association chair and Maryland governor, said in an interview with POLITICO. Health care and home costs topped the target list. Several newly elected Democratic governors — Jocelyn Benson in Michigan, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia, Deb Haaland in New Mexico and Rob Sand in Iowa — plan to take action to lower health costs, ranging from caps on prescription drug prices to expanding Medicaid coverage, within days of taking office. California Gov.-elect Xavier Becerra promised to spur affordable housing construction. His Nevada counterpart, Aaron Ford, said he plans to limit corporations purchasing private homes, and is preparing a day-one executive order to task every state agency with “finding ways to put money back in people's pockets.” “You hear people signing executive orders to make things easier for businesses, cut regulations, and make it easier to do business. I think that's cool, that's fine, that's dandy,” Ford said in an interview. “But if you can do it for businesses, you can do it for people, too.” Affordability was, far and away, the top issue for voters this cycle. Results from The POLITICO Poll, conducted just days after the midterm elections, found a 47% plurality of Americans — including 59% of Democratic voters and 41% of Republicans — said affordability and the economy were among the main issues driving their vote. Democrats’ tsunami washed over governors’ mansions across the nation: They won 24 of the 36 governor’s races held this month, flipping red states like Texas, Alaska and Ohio, and will hold 30 of the 50 governorships nationwide next year — the most in three decades. These governors and soon-to-be governors will be buoyed by a boon of Democrats in their statehouses: Democrats won unified control of government in Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada and Wisconsin; in North Carolina, Democrats flipped the House for the first time in 16 years and broke Republicans’ supermajority in the Senate. As several inches of snow descended on the Wasatch Front and blanketed the glitzy ski resort in Park City this week, the newly elected governors sheltered inside the NGA’s New Governors Leadership Forum — colloquially called “baby governors’ school.” At the two-day seminar, the incoming state executives and their teams attended seminars and workshops, mingled over hors d'oeuvres and heard from current and former governors on what to expect. Former President Bill Clinton, sitting spread-legged in a Team USA sweater Thursday, dished to a room full of governors on his book recommendations (“The Social Conquest of Earth” by E.O. Wilson), fun facts (“The combined weight of ants on earth exceeds the combined weight of all the people on earth!”) and political predictions (“I think if President Trump gets closer to leaving, he may get more interested in leaving actual legacies in forms other than buildings.”) Clinton, who chaired the NGA when he served as governor of Arkansas, also offered some advice to the newly electeds: “The most important thing is that you and your Cabinet and your office and your organizations out in the state know what your priorities are and know what your progress is.” Governors will face a steep climb to deliver immediate relief to Americans. Economic forces are national and international, and much of the past year’s price spikes, from fuel to food to energy, can be tied to the Iran war. Bottoms said she will immediately begin to prepare Georgia agencies for Medicaid expansion, and expects the state legislature — with Democrats now in control of the state House, while Republicans still control the state Senate — to cooperate. “I do believe this is an issue we will get bipartisan support on,” she told POLITICO. In addition to his Day-One executive order, Ford says he plans to work with the Nevada legislature to sign bills in his first 30 days on expanding free public school meals, lowering the cost of prescription drugs to the Medicaid negotiated price and limiting corporations’ ability to buy private homes. Benson said she has already reached out to the Trump administration about tariffs, which includes a 50% tariff on most Canadian exports and have disproportionately impacted Michiganders. She said she has not yet heard back, but “the point is I have reached out, and I do hope to have that conversation.” She also emphasized her focus on lowering health care costs. “That's life or death for so many families,” Benson said. Megan Messerly and Adam Wren contributed reporting.
articles.headline: New Democratic governors race to deliver relief on costs

articles.body: Iowa Gov.-elect Rob Sand isn’t indulging any consideration of him as a potential 2028 presidential candidate. Sand, who cemented himself as a rising star in the party by flipping the governor’s seat in Iowa with a commanding 11-point victory, said in an onstage interview at the POLITICO Pub on the sidelines of the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum that he’s unlikely to ever consider running for president. “Are you completely taking 2028 off the table?” POLITICO’s Adam Wren asked Sand. “Yes,” he replied. When asked if he would ever consider running for president, Sand curtly replied, “Doubt it.” Sand offered a tongue-in-cheek rebuttal to the suggestion that he could position himself as an influential voice and a power broker in the national conversation ahead of the next election. “Ooh, that sounds exciting,” Sand quipped sarcastically before adding, “I expect to be a governor in 2027 and in 2028.” Sand also declined to weigh in on his preference for who Democrats should nominate in the presidential primaries. Asked to choose between Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear, Arizona Sen. Mark Kelly and former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg — all of whom campaigned for Democrats in Iowa in the midterms — Sand refused to take the bait. “We have forever to go on all of this,” he said. “The people who want to do that, they're going to get in the race. They're going to do things. They're going to say things. We'll learn a lot more. Then we'll have a clear opinion about who should be doing what.” Sand reiterated that he intends to keep Iowa’s Democratic caucuses as the first nominating contest on the calendar despite the Democratic Party removing Iowa from its early state lineup and encouraged Democratic presidential candidates to continue the tradition of visiting Iowa’s state fair next year. “I'm pretty confident that we'll figure something out that means we're following Iowa law, and they're going to be able to do that,” he said.
articles.headline: Rob Sand shuts down any talk of 2028

articles.body: Democrats want fighters. Massachusetts Gov. Maura Healey believes they want healers, too. Healey, a Democrat who easily won a second term in the deep-blue state earlier this month, told POLITICO on Thursday that she’d like to see her party’s next presidential nominee show “decency” and “humanity.” “It’s really important that we have leaders who genuinely see people, understand their situation. If you don't see people, if you don't understand people, you're never going to be able to deliver for them,” Healey said during an interview at the POLITICO Pub on the sidelines of the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Deer Valley, Utah. “Having leaders who have that, and who have a strong moral compass, I think that's really important,” she told POLITICO’s Adam Wren. Healey suggested the midterms offered a “resetting” as the nation moves toward a post-Donald Trump era. Pressed on whether it’s more important for Democrats to nominate a fighter or a healer, Healey — who burnished her national profile as a hard-charging state attorney general who sued the first Trump administration dozens of times and urged Democrats to more aggressively oppose his second — insisted good leaders can do both. “You can be a uniter and a fighter; you can be a fighter and a healer,” she said. It’s a debate that’s already driving the earliest stages of Democrats’ shadow 2028 primary as the party’s rising stars try to discern whether voters who powered their midterm wave want a brawler or a uniter after candidates of both stripes won difficult races. Healey ruled out a 2028 presidential bid of her own on Thursday. And she deflected when asked whether Democrats should nominate a governor. But the Massachusetts governor, who has close relationships with several likely contenders and routinely hits the campaign trail for Democrats in the early primary state of New Hampshire, could play a role in shaping the primary.
articles.headline: Massachusetts gov says Dems want ‘a uniter and a fighter’ for 2028

articles.body: Georgia Democratic Gov.-elect Keisha Lance Bottoms said the midterm election results “have spoken for themselves” in showing the need for the Democratic Party to invest more in the South. “I would hope that in two years, we're not having to beg and borrow to be able to run successful campaigns,” Bottoms said in an onstage interview at the POLITICO Pub on the sidelines of the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Utah. Democrats had a historically strong cycle in Georgia this year: Bottoms became the first Democrat to win her state’s governorship in more than a quarter-century, Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff won reelection handily, and the party flipped the state House for the first time in more than two decades. But it wasn’t just Georgia. Democrats also won Senate seats in North Carolina, South Carolina and Mississippi, three states that have long been out of reach for the party, and just missed in Louisiana. “The numbers have been there for Democrats to flip that seat in Mississippi for a while, but the investment has not been there,” Bottoms said. She said that her campaign was a lean operation, particularly in contrast to her GOP opponent’s. Rick Jackson spent nearly $200 million of his own money on his campaign. “During the primary it was the shoestring, dental floss campaign, we were holding it together with every single thing that we had because we weren't getting in the resources and some people have written Georgia off,” she said. “But also even when those resources come from our friends nationally: Trust us. Nobody knows their community, nobody knows their electorate better than the people who are living and breathing it every single day.” Bottoms made history as the first-ever Black woman ever elected governor to in the U.S. earlier this month. But on her campaign trail, she did not focus on the historic nature of her candidacy. “I wake up as a Black woman every day,” she said. “So it was not something that I felt compelled to talk about, it was never top of mind, so it was not even a conscious decision for me not to talk about it. I just didn’t think about it.” She said she instead focused on voters’ cost of living concerns that dominated the cycle. “For me, it was about focusing on the issues. I can't hide, and don't want to hide, that I'm a Black woman,” she said. “To the extent that the conversations were organic with me as a mother or as a woman or whatever the case may have been, then it was a part of the discussion. But I can tell you, as I moved around the state of Georgia, people were focused on, ‘what are you gonna do about this cost of living? How are you going to make my life better?’”
articles.headline: Keisha Lance Bottoms says Democrats better spend big on the South

articles.body: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear defended his decision not to invest more in Gina Hinojosa’s successful race for Texas governor in an interview with POLITICO, amid criticism that could derail his own potential presidential ambitions. Beshear, the chair of the Democratic Governors Association, took heat this month when Latino Democratic operatives and Hinojosa allies publicly maligned him for failing to do enough to help Hinojosa over the finish line. “There might have been frustration by folks who just really wanted to win that race, but they did, and she did, and we're very excited to have her a part of the DGA room,” Beshear said Thursday. “Did we spend a little more money, say, in Kansas, where we were trying to protect the seat? Yes, but we only won that race by 7,000 votes," he said. In a stunning victory, Hinojosa won Texas by 7 percentage points. Hinojosa’s allies’ say that their calls for the DGA to support her campaign went unanswered for months. Ultimately, the DGA contributed $1.4 million — a far cry from the $19 million the organization invested in Keisha Lance Bottoms’ successful bid to win Georgia’s governorship. But Beshear said the context matters. When the budget for this campaign cycle started at the end of 2024, Democrats had suffered brutal losses. “We built out our map protecting our incumbents,” Beshear said. “We were going to be lucky to get [Arizona Gov.] Katie Hobbs and [Oregon Gov.] Tina Kotek reelected, and we were going to have tough elections, even in places potentially like Pennsylvania.” Democrats Abigail Spanberger in Virginia and Mikie Sherrill in New Jersey both won gubernatorial victories in 2025 on affordability platforms, which helped propel them to victory at a time when the economy had become a key pressure point for voters. Heading into 2026, Beshear said, "what came online were the first set of flips, where the earliest polling indicated it was possible, and those were Iowa, Ohio, Georgia and Nevada. And so at that point, we already had the largest DGA map ever." “We had a size 10 budget with a size 14 map, and then what happened? Alaska, Nebraska, Oklahoma, Texas and Florida all became or seemed competitive as well, which meant we had a size 10 budget with a size 16 map," Beshear said. The party flipped six governorships in states that President Donald Trump won. In January, Democrats will control 30 governorships and the majority of state legislative chambers. “So at the end of the day, I think we're judged by results,” Beshear said. “And I get that every campaign wants as much funding as they can, but Gina won in Texas, and I'm excited for her.” While Beshear hasn’t publicly announced a run for president in 2028, he’s already crafting his pitch. “If you look at what we've done in Kentucky, the ability to do that all across this country would be special for so many other communities that deserve better jobs, more accessible health care and a better life for our people,” he said. Despite his role as chair of the DGA, Beshear argues that of all the rumored candidates out there, he would be the “ultimate outsider.” He’s not from “inside the Beltway” or either coast. He would be “a candidate from where the South meets the Midwest,” he said — a governor who has helped “improve and revive a place that the country for many years left out.” Beshear says that Bottoms’ victory in Georgia showed Democrats can win in the South. “I am a Southern governor that has won in a red state, and so I knew a great candidate when I saw one,” he said. “And together, our financial support plus her grassroots campaign that turned out voters sent a message that the South is winnable and that the Deep South is winnable.” Next up? Mississippi and Louisiana, Beshear said. “You look at Mississippi, where three years ago the election was close and will be again,” he said. “And then, depending on the candidate we get in Louisiana, the governor there has incredibly low approval ratings, and so even though that's going up against an incumbent, I think the seat is very much in play.” In 2023, Mississippi Gov. Tate Reeves defeated his Democratic nominee Brandon Presley by 3.24 percentage points. Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry took office in January 2024.
articles.headline: Beshear defends Texas strategy

articles.body: CHICAGO — The head of the Democratic Attorneys General Association is stepping down after a successful 2026 cycle in which their party flipped Republican-held attorney general offices in five states, including the conservative legal powerhouse of Texas. Sean Rankin started as executive director at the group — known as DAGA — in 2016, and oversaw its operations as Democratic attorneys general banded together to challenge the first Trump administration over a range of issues. He became president of the group in 2022 and is credited with raising nearly $250 million for DAGA and its affiliated entities over the past decade. “Since Sean joined DAGA in 2016, the committee has won the majority of their competitive races” against Republicans, “reshaping the map for Democrats,” the group said Thursday. Rankin will stay at DAGA as it conducts a search for his successor. Democrats will take control of at least five additional attorney general offices in January, following wins in Texas, Georgia, Ohio, Kansas and Iowa. Alaska, which just elected a Democratic governor, is also expected to have a Democratic attorney general, since the governor appoints the state's top lawyer. “On Texas, we took the head of the snake. So fundamentally, there will be a change in how the Republican attorneys general have to engage nationally if they do not have Texas at the front,” Rankin told POLITICO in a wide-ranging interview after the midterms earlier this month. “Texas has played an outsized role in the actions taken, in my opinion, against many of the issues that I care about, that the AGs fight for, that we believe the American people support — having Texas not on the other side, that’s a game changer.”
articles.headline: Leader of Democratic AG group to step down after Texas triumph

articles.body: North Carolina Gov. Josh Stein said his state needs to roll back subsidies for data centers, telling POLITICO that Big Tech companies should be “paying their own way.” “I think the idea that this industry needs any public incentive is laughable. These are the wealthiest companies in the history of humanity. They have more resources than many nations. So we, little North Carolina, should not be giving subsidies,” Stein said in an interview Thursday at the POLITICO Pub at the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Deer Valley, Utah. The Democratic governor pointed to subsidies in North Carolina for electricity for data centers that were rolled back earlier this year , along with ongoing subsidies for the purchase of new equipment, which he said ought to be phased out. “For new data centers, why are we giving them any public dollar when they should be subsidizing the ratepayers?” he said. Stein, elected in 2024, will be governing with a divided Legislature next year after Democrats flipped North Carolina’s House of Representatives this year and broke the Republican supermajority in the state Senate amid a nationwide blue wave . Republicans are likely to maintain narrow control of the upper chamber pending a recount in a pivotal race. The first-term governor, who won by nearly 15 points in 2024 despite President Donald Trump also winning the state that year, didn’t commit to running again in 2028 but said he “cannot think of any” reasons not to. Stein touted bipartisan work in the state to address recovery from Hurricane Helene, which devastated western North Carolina in 2024. But he faulted “one of the most ineffectual Congresses in history” for failing to deliver for the state. The $60 billion in damages North Carolina suffered, he noted, are nearly as large of a sum as the state’s two-year budget — making it impossible for the state to allocate enough funds for recovery. He said that he spoke to Trump earlier this year and was told that hurricane recovery was a priority for the president, but the necessary federal funds have not come through. “The state stepped up,” Stein said. “The people of Western North Carolina have truly stepped up, and it's time for the federal government to step up.”
articles.headline: ‘They should be subsidizing the ratepayers’: NC governor says data center subsidies should be rolled back

articles.body: Nevada Democratic Gov.-elect Aaron Ford is vowing to immediately pass a trifecta of measures that he says will drive down the cost of living when he enters office in the key swing state. “Those are concrete things that immediately can bring some level of effect to this cost-of-living crisis that we're experiencing right now,” Ford told POLITICO’s Megan Messerly in an onstage interview at the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Utah. The legislative blitz includes a bill to make school breakfast and lunch free for public school students, legislation that would limit the cost of prescription drugs to the Medicare-negotiated price for everybody and new rules aimed at lowering housing costs that would limit the number of homes corporations can purchase. “I've been working with my colleagues already in the Legislature, and we're going to sign bills beginning on Day 1,” Ford said. “We'll be signing bills within the first 30 days to ensure that we can start effectuating some of the promises that I made on the campaign trail. “You hear people signing executive orders to make things easier for businesses — cut regulations and make it easier to do business — I think that’s cool, that’s fine, and that’s dandy. But if you could do it for businesses, you could do it for people too,” he also said. The incoming Nevada governor and former state attorney general also emphasized his willingness to work across the aisle — even though the massive Democratic wins in his state earlier this month make it so “I don't need one Republican vote to get something done in my state right now,” he said. Nevada will be the second state to vote in the Democratic primaries in 2028, and Ford said candidates need to come and travel up and down the state before staking out policy positions. “You need to come to Nevada. Period. Point blank,” Ford said. “We’re one of the most diverse states in the nation. If you can convince a Nevadan that you’re worth your salt, you may very well be able to convince the rest of the nation that you are.” And he cautioned Democrats against making assumptions on what Nevadans want and need. “Don’t presume you know what their issues are,” he said. “Don’t be high and mighty and highfalutin and sitting in some ivory tower putting out ideas when you haven’t heard them say to you what their concerns are.”
articles.headline: Nevada's new governor promises legislative blitz on affordability

articles.body: Vice President JD Vance took aim at Kevin Stitt, calling the Republican governor of Oklahoma’s push for bipartisan immigration reform “morally and electorally disastrous.” “I like Kevin, but what does ‘bipartisan immigration reform’ mean?” Vance wrote on X on Thursday morning. “If you mean making it harder for megacompanies to defraud our visa system, great. If you mean we should pass legislation to make it harder for employers to violate our immigration law, I'm all ears,” Vance wrote. “But to a lot of people, this sounds like an effort to give amnesty to people who have broken our laws. It is morally and electorally disastrous.” The vice president was responding to comments the Oklahoma Republican made at the POLITICO Pub on the sidelines of the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Park City, Utah, on Wednesday. “We need to have a strong border. We need to know who is coming into our country. We need to vet those people,” Stitt said. Stitt described President Donald Trump as a “businessperson” who “understands the need for a workforce.” “He can lead on this, he can fix this immigration policy,” the Oklahoma governor said. But he blamed Congress and other interests in Washington for standing in the way of reform. “It’s not that complicated. But the problem is Washington, D.C., each side thinks they’re winning on it. They raise money off of it. They politic off of it. They try to crush the other side over these issues instead of fixing it for the American people,” Stitt said. “That’s why you saw this huge swing in the midterms.” Asked about Vance’s comments on Thursday, Stitt told POLITICO he was “super pumped that the vice president is being engaged in the conversations.” “The governors have been leading on this,” Stitt added. “Republican governors, Democrat governors, have a lot to say on immigration policy, and I am glad the vice president is listening.” Stitt has long called for sweeping changes to immigration policy, including enabling state governors to issue work permits to unauthorized immigrants. Vance – who is weighing a run for the White House in 2028 – has been a staunch defender of the Trump administration’s aggressive crackdown on illegal immigration. Trump has signaled he is open to cutting a deal on immigration reform in the wake of his party’s midterm defeats. The president told CBS News’s “60 Minutes” earlier this month that his deportation policy was “ too tough ” and had hurt Republicans with some midterm voters. But any agreement still seems unlikely. The same day he spoke to “60 Minutes,” Trump named immigration hardliner Stephen Miller to be White House chief of staff. Asked about the possibility of a deal earlier this week, Trump told reporters at the White House: “It would be wonderful, but we’ll see.” The president said any agreement would “have to be tough” and offer “no amnesty” for unauthorized immigrants.
articles.headline: JD Vance slams GOP governor’s call for immigration reform as ‘morally and electorally disastrous’

articles.body: Allies of former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg are launching an independent, grassroots effort urging him to undertake a second presidential campaign ahead of 2028. Team Pete PAC will be led by Jennifer Holdsworth, the former national campaign manager of Buttigieg’s unsuccessful 2017 bid for DNC chair, and Mohsin Syed, his former chief of staff at the Transportation Department. The PAC is aiming to bring together volunteers and grassroots donors who backed Buttigieg’s 2020 presidential bid. “Mohsin and I have traveled the country this year, and everywhere we go, people ask us the same question: how can I help Pete?” Holdsworth said in a statement. Team Pete PAC is independent and has no ties to Buttigieg’s Win the Era PAC, nor is it a presidential committee. Through Win the Era, Buttigieg campaigned with 102 candidates across the map for the midterms, visiting 38 states (19 of them twice). Asked on MS NOW’s “Morning Joe” on Wednesday whether he had a timeline to make a decision, Buttigieg said he would be “surprised” if he was the first potential 2028 presidential candidate “to make news” and said he’s “certainly not cooking up anything to announce in the next few weeks.” Even as it forms to press Buttigieg to mount a second presidential campaign, Team Pete PAC is urging potential backers to take part in community service — a nod to Buttigeig’s proposed national service program he proposed as a candidate. “I’ve seen up close what Pete can do,” Syed said. “He has a unique ability to bring people together and inspire action.”
articles.headline: Buttigieg allies launch effort to back another presidential run

articles.body: <p>Los asesores de Alberto Núñez Feijóo entraban estos días en su despacho en la sede del PP para hablarle de algún asunto y, de repente, le soltaban sin venir a cuento una pregunta incómoda. El líder del PP sabía que, en ese caso, estaba obligado a responder rápido a esa pregunta sorpresa que le había lanzado alguno de sus colaboradores, por muy impertinente que resultara. Esas invectivas inesperadas eran parte del entrenamiento del líder del PP para el debate electoral que le enfrentó este jueves con el presidente socialista, que ganó Feijóo, según <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/feijoo-gano-el-cara-a-cara-contra-sanchez-por-10-puntos-segun-el-sondeo-de-40db-para-el-pais-y-la-ser.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/feijoo-gano-el-cara-a-cara-contra-sanchez-por-10-puntos-segun-el-sondeo-de-40db-para-el-pais-y-la-ser.html">el sondeo de 40dB. para EL PAÍS</a>. “Así ensayábamos cómo iba de reflejos”, cuenta uno de los integrantes del equipo que preparó con el candidato esa prueba decisiva. Los populares no dejaron nada al azar y trabajaron a conciencia el examen: además de las preguntas sin guion, Feijóo estudió 400 folios de documentación entre mitin y mitin. Llegado el día del debate, tenía todo tan preparado que incluso durmió una siesta. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/400-folios-y-preguntas-por-sorpresa-para-entrenar-los-reflejos-asi-se-preparo-feijoo-para-el-cara-a-cara-con-sanchez.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/SI2SDOYCQREARH6V2ZFW377POU.jpg?auth=9c05b12c3b2630f0467fdc9f48f9b246b77c7ee94998ce7ca8dd5fbdfa0e48c4" width="6960" height="4640" alt="Alberto Núñez Feijóo entra en el mitin del Partido Popular en Salamanca."></img><p>Los dos primeros actos de campaña del aspirante a revalidar el Gobierno, <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/pedro-sanchez-perez-castejon/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/pedro-sanchez-perez-castejon/">Pedro Sánchez</a>, reflejan la necesidad de los líderes de conservar a toda costa sus grandes feudos a la vez que protegen sus posiciones en las provincias pequeñas. El candidato del PSOE arrancó la contienda en Sevilla, el histórico granero socialista donde hay en juego 12 de los 60 escaños de Andalucía. A continuación, eligió León, donde hay en liza cuatro de los 28 diputados correspondientes a <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/castilla-y-leon/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/castilla-y-leon/">Castilla y León</a>. Ahí Sánchez tiene un segundo parlamentario de juego. Lo mismo ocurre en Burgos, donde también asistió. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/la-gran-batalla-de-psoe-pp-y-vox-por-los-votos-decisivos-de-las-provincias-pequenas-y-medianas.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/ZEQNRU6MONFRXJTW5HBJNFWE4I.jpg?auth=aad0a7ab091497a8cc9bee2d85c9f24c9f0fec5ec516838ffc373f87c81fad8a" width="3300" height="1856" alt="El tren AVE de Renfe accidentado en Urda (Toledo) el 28 de octubre."></img><p>El sector constructor y grandes fondos, el capital privado en definitiva, serán convocados por el Partido Popular para armar <a href="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-11-10/el-pp-se-compromete-a-convocar-elecciones-si-prorroga-los-presupuestos-en-dos-ocasiones.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-11-10/el-pp-se-compromete-a-convocar-elecciones-si-prorroga-los-presupuestos-en-dos-ocasiones.html">un plan de infraestructuras de 300.000 millones</a> a 15 años si el día 29 de noviembre alcanza el Gobierno. El transporte ferroviario está en el centro de esta promesa de 11 ceros. El PSOE, por su parte, propone atajar la permanente crisis del ferrocarril con un compromiso que multiplica el gasto previsto en mantenimiento de las vías hasta 2030, con 19.000 millones que deberán rascarse de próximos Presupuestos Generales del Estado. Son montañas de inversión y gasto, especialmente en la alta velocidad, que han saltado a una campaña electoral alterada desde su arranque por <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-05/las-vidas-que-se-pararon-para-siempre-en-urda.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-05/las-vidas-que-se-pararon-para-siempre-en-urda.html">el accidente ferroviario del 28 de octubre en Urda (Toledo)</a> y la posterior <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-04/puente-se-aparta-para-intentar-salvar-la-campana-del-psoe-pese-al-respaldo-de-sanchez-a-su-gestion.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-04/puente-se-aparta-para-intentar-salvar-la-campana-del-psoe-pese-al-respaldo-de-sanchez-a-su-gestion.html">renuncia al cargo de ministro de Transportes</a> de un alfil de PSOE como era Óscar Puente. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/miles-de-millones-para-el-ferrocarril-garantizar-la-seguridad-en-la-alta-velocidad-decanta-votos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/K6IQIMAHNVB7FMJEMIRN5N42XI.jpg?auth=f60180b39978f759d4c9f438ee4384f08fe59f0369ba4ec4808dec2ebfd5df70" width="5000" height="3333" alt="El abogado y expolítico Miquel Roca, en su despacho de Barcelona el pasado martes."></img><p>Se ha presentado a seis elecciones generales y ha votado en las 16 que ha habido. <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/miquel-roca-junyent/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/miquel-roca-junyent/">Miquel Roca</a>, uno de los siete padres de la Constitución, responde al teléfono desde su despacho de abogados de Barcelona con su proverbial elocuencia intacta a los 86 años: “Como hace tiempo que no hablo, cuando hablo me aprovecho”. A quien no piense votar en esta convocatoria le diría que “ha costado mucho, <i>mucho, mucho, mucho</i> poder votar”. Lo repite cuatro veces. “<a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2025-11-17/miquel-roca-abogado-lo-que-fue-la-dictadura-no-se-ha-explicado-jamas.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2025-11-17/miquel-roca-abogado-lo-que-fue-la-dictadura-no-se-ha-explicado-jamas.html">Detrás del ejercicio del voto hay gente anónima que ha sufrido represión, persecución, algunos han dejado la vida... Votar es una obligación democrática</a>. ¿Que a usted no le gusta aquel político o el otro? Lo respeto, pero vote. ¿Quiere votar en blanco? Hágalo, yo qué quiere que le diga. Es su decisión. Pero hay que votar, es una gran victoria a la que no podemos renunciar. En este país a veces no valoramos la libertad hasta que la perdemos. Y la libertad es ejercer el voto”. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/miquel-roca-ganar-la-democracia-es-apasionante-pero-vivir-en-ella-es-dificil.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/ZJH7BVSLZBH3FGTOMVPG4MZSF4.jpg?auth=7698b3866b850f7197b1e5f9bb1407cfbbb1e8b2a50321bb2654d2271708994f" width="5000" height="3333" alt="El abogado y expolítico Miquel Roca, en su despacho de Barcelona, el martes 17 de noviembre."></img>
articles.headline: Miquel Roca: “Ganar la democracia es apasionante. Pero vivir en ella es difícil”

articles.body: <p>En medio del ruido mediático por un posible pronunciamiento sobre la orientación al voto, la Conferencia Episcopal Española (CEE) ha presentado este jueves el primer informe sobre los delitos de odio contra católicos en España cometidos en 2025 y elaborado por su Oficina de Libertad Religiosa. Pero su publicación ha pasado desapercibida. También una de las dos personas que los obispos españoles han elegido para presentarlo ante los medios: Ricardo García García, ex alto cargo del Gobierno de Carlos Mazón durante la dana de 2024 <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/comunidad-valenciana/2026-07-10/la-jueza-investiga-a-un-ex-alto-cargo-de-la-generalitat-valenciana-por-un-audio-manipulado-de-la-dana.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/comunidad-valenciana/2026-07-10/la-jueza-investiga-a-un-ex-alto-cargo-de-la-generalitat-valenciana-por-un-audio-manipulado-de-la-dana.html">e imputado por presuntamente manipular un audio que luego difundió el entonces <i>president</i></a> con una versión sesgada de la riada. El investigado, catedrático de Derecho Eclesiástico del Estado, es técnico y asesor externo de la CEE en asuntos de libertad religiosa y ha desempeñado cargos públicos desde 2008 con gobiernos de diferentes partidos. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-21/los-obispos-colocan-en-la-presentacion-de-su-informe-sobre-delitos-de-odio-al-expolitico-imputado-por-manipular-un-audio-de-la-dana.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>El 43% de los ciudadanos considera que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/feijoo-enmienda-ocho-anos-de-gobierno-ante-un-sanchez-que-evita-la-confrontacion.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/feijoo-enmienda-ocho-anos-de-gobierno-ante-un-sanchez-que-evita-la-confrontacion.html">el líder del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ganó el cara a cara</a> celebrado este jueves, según el sondeo realizado durante la pasada noche y esta mañana por 40dB., frente al 33,3% que asegura que el ganador del debate fue el candidato socialista, Pedro Sánchez. Hay un 16,4% de los participantes en la encuesta que no apuntan a ninguno de los candidatos como ganador del encuentro. En el sondeo, un 76,3% aseguró que había visto el encuentro, 20 puntos más que el cara a cara entre Sánchez y Feijóo de 2023, cuando un 53,4% dijo haberlo seguido. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/feijoo-gano-el-cara-a-cara-contra-sanchez-por-10-puntos-segun-el-sondeo-de-40db-para-el-pais-y-la-ser.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Alberto Núñez Feijóo fue en tromba contra Pedro Sánchez, no solo con una enmienda a la totalidad de sus ocho años de gestión, sino cuestionando una y otra vez tanto la competencia como la integridad y decencia del presidente. Ante las descargas de Feijóo, siempre en tono acusatorio, el candidato socialista evitó el choque, adoptando una actitud por momentos autocrítica, respondiendo a los duros golpes de su adversario con cierta mesura. Es la síntesis del primer —y único— cara a cara entre los dos principales aspirantes a la presidencia, que tuvo lugar este jueves. Aunque primero en las encuestas y favorito para llegar a La Moncloa, Feijóo renunció al papel de solemnidad presidencial y se lanzó a degüello contra Sánchez, que, aunque necesitado de remontada, optó por <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/sanchez-intenta-recuperar-votantes-moderados-con-un-inesperado-tono-suave.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/sanchez-intenta-recuperar-votantes-moderados-con-un-inesperado-tono-suave.html">minimizar el cuerpo a cuerpo</a> y centrarse en la defensa de su gestión. A diferencia del <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2023-07-10/mentiras-y-medias-verdades-del-debate-de-atresmedia-entre-sanchez-y-feijoo.html" rel="">debate de 2023</a>, no se exasperó ante su adversario.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/feijoo-enmienda-ocho-anos-de-gobierno-ante-un-sanchez-que-evita-la-confrontacion.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>En el día después <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/mentiras-y-medias-verdades-del-debate-cara-a-cara-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-nunez-feijoo.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/mentiras-y-medias-verdades-del-debate-cara-a-cara-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-nunez-feijoo.html">al debate,</a> ese que según la mayoría de expertos y encuestas perdió frente a Alberto Núñez Feijóo, Pedro Sánchez se ha cobrado una revancha. Lo ha hecho sobre una cancha de baloncesto y donde más le duele al candidato del PP: su Galicia natal, la que gobernó 13 años. El socialista ha llenado este viernes el Multiusos de Fontes do Sar de Santiago, hogar del club de baloncesto Obradoiro y el mismo recinto en el que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-20/feijoo-promete-en-la-restinga-fronteras-y-seguridad-y-condicionar-la-ayuda-al-desarrollo-al-control-migratorio.html" target="_blank" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-20/feijoo-promete-en-la-restinga-fronteras-y-seguridad-y-condicionar-la-ayuda-al-desarrollo-al-control-migratorio.html">Feijóo</a> tuvo que dejar las gradas superiores cerradas el pasado sábado en un acto de su partido. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/sanchez-se-toma-la-revancha-en-galicia-y-esgrime-contra-feijoo-el-derecho-a-la-eutanasia-votemos-en-homenaje-a-ramon-sampedro.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: El comboi Solidaritat amb Ucraïna ha partit aquest divendres en direcció cap a aquest país amb ajuda humanitària. La iniciativa europea, formada per tres rutes diferents, farà arribar als ucraïnesos ajuda humanitària com ara generadors, estufes, material sanitari i altres recursos per fer front al fred hivernal . Més enllà de la solidaritat, aquest projecte també vol reforçar els vincles entre institucions, moviments socials i les societats civils d’Europa i Ucraïna. David Acosta, director del comboi, ha destacat el caràcter internacional de la iniciativa, amb la participació de més de deu països que “posen rumb cap a Ucraïna” . Ha remarcat la importància de fer arribar ajuda humanitària al país, on durant l’hivern les temperatures poden arribar als 20 graus sota zero. Acosta també ha fet una crida als mitjans de comunicació perquè “no oblidin que la guerra continua” i ha lamentat que “moltes vegades queda silenciada”. Finalment, ha reivindicat la importància de la solidaritat ciutadana amb un missatge contundent: “Només el poble salva el poble”. També et pot interessar Barcelona signa un acord de cooperació amb la ciutat ucraïnesa de Khàrkiv Javier Arilla 1 minut de lectura Material del Banc del Moviment Entre el material que es farà arribar a la població ucraïnesa a través del comboi Solidaritat amb Ucraïna, destaca la donació del Banc del Moviment. Aquest servei, gestionat per l’Institut Municipal de Persones amb Discapacitat, ha donat cadires de rodes, caminadors, grues d’elevació i altres productes per facilitar la mobilitat i l’atenció a persones vulnerables. Gairebé cinc anys de conflicte bèl·lic Després de gairebé cinc anys de guerra amb Rússia , l’Ajuntament de Barcelona ha coordinat diverses missions humanitàries i ha finançat múltiples projectes d’emergència humanitària a través d’organismes internacionals i ONG. Al mes de març, el consistori va enviar el quart comboi humanitari ; un mes abans, va participar en el corredor humanitari de la Bondad, liderada per sor Lucía Caram , amb set generadors d’electricitat. Durant el 2025, Barcelona també va fer arribar una desena d’autobusos a Ucraïna per garantir la mobilitat de les víctimes del conflicte bèl·lic. articles.body: Barcelona té una col·lecció de tramvies, autobusos i troleibusos històrics , però continua sense disposar d’un espai estable on exposar aquest patrimoni. La Coordinadora pro Museu del Transport fa més de mig segle que reclama un museu que permeti conservar i mostrar aquests vehicles. Manel Marina, membre de l’entitat, ha assegurat a l ‘Infobarris que “tenim un patrimoni molt ric a Barcelona “, però lamenta que encara no s’hagi trobat un emplaçament definitiu: “ Necessitem un lloc estable per poder-lo exposar” . Davant el fracàs de les negociacions, l’entitat ha optat per la via contenciosa administrativa. Tot i això asseguren: “Mantenim la porta oberta al diàleg i reiterem la nostra voluntat d’arribar a una solució consensuada”. Dos contenciosos administratius La Coordinadora ha presentat dos contenciosos administratius : un contra l’acord de la Subcomissió d’Urbanisme de Barcelona d’aprovació del PEiMU (Pla especial integral i de millora urbana) de l’àmbit dels pavellons firals de Montjuïc, i l’altre, contra l’acord municipal de concessió a la Fira Internacional de Barcelona de l’ús privatiu del domini públic sobre els esmentats pavellons. L’entitat explica que aquesta decisió és fruit de “ la negativa de l’alcalde de Barcelona i el seu equip a mantenir cap mena de diàleg sobre la possibilitat que un d’aquests pavellons firals , l’antic Palau de Comunicacions i Transports, sigui habilitat com a Museu del Transport de Barcelona “. Marina recorda que la iniciativa ciutadana per reclamar aquest emplaçament va aconseguir 4.000 signatures i que la proposta va rebre el suport unànime del plenari municipal. Tot i això, critica la falta d’avenços i assegura que “la majoria dels partits polítics estan mirant cap a l’altre costat “. Alternatives, sense consens La proposta de situar el futur Museu del Transport a la llosa de la Vall d’Hebron no convenç la Coordinadora. Considera que l’espai previst, que segons Manel Marina no arribaria als 2.500 metres quadrats, és insuficient per a les necessitats de l’equipament. Ho resumeix amb una comparació contundent: “ Si el museu necessita dos camps de futbol, ens estan oferint una pista de tennis “. La Coordinadora també reclama més concreció sobre el projecte de la Vall d’Hebron. Segons Marina, “no hi ha ni projecte ” i, fins ara, afirma que només els han mostrat “una fotografia del Google Earth i poca cosa més “. Mig segle de reclamacions Per a la Coordinadora, el problema ve de lluny. Marina resumeix la reivindicació amb una frase: “És una decisió política que fa 50 anys que espera “. I reivindica la paradoxa d’una ciutat amb una llarga història vinculada a la mobilitat però que encara no disposa d’aquest equipament: “Barcelona ha estat sempre pionera en el tema del transport. El que passa és que després, a l’hora de la veritat, ha arribat tard “. L’entrevista sencera a l’ Infobarris

articles.body: El sorteig de la segona eliminatòria de la Copa del Rei se celebrarà aquest dilluns, 23 de novembre, a partir de les 12.30 h. En aquesta eliminatòria hi participaran l’Europa i el Sant Andreu , que van eliminar el Calamocha i el CE Manresa en la primera ronda . En total, en aquesta eliminatòria hi participen 56 equips, dels quals cinc són catalans.m Els dos equips barcelonins podrien enfrontar-se a un equip de la Primera o de la Segona Divisió. També et pot interessar L’Europa es guanya el premi de viure una nit de Copa del Rei al Nou Sardenya Europa i Sant Andreu, molt pendents del sorteig Aquest dilluns, 23 de novembre, tindrà lloc a la seu de la Federació Espanyola de Futbol el sorteig de la segona eliminatòria de la Copa del Rei . Es podrà seguir a través dels canals de la Federació . Dimecres, 18 de novembre, es van celebrar les últimes eliminatòries de la primera ronda que van ser ajornades tant per l’accident de tren a Urda com per la mort del jugador del Tenerife, Jesús de Miguel . 56 equips estaran involucrats en el sorteig, dels quals 15 són de Primera Divisió , 18 de Segona Divisió , 14 de Primera Federació , vuit de Segona Federació i el campió de la Copa Federació . Entre aquests, estan l ‘Europa i el Sant Andreu . El grup Nord, el grup de l’Europa i el Sant Andreu Des de la temporada passada, en les dues primeres eliminatòries, es divideixen els equips en dos grups segons la proximitat geogràfica. Aquests són el grup nord i el grup sud . Tant l’equip gracienc com el quadribarrat estan en el primer grup, o sigui, el nord, juntament amb la resta d’equips catalans com el Reus , el Girona i el Sabadell , o altres equips de Primera com el Vila-real, l’Athletic Club, el Getafe o el Celta , o de Segona com el Castelló , l’Sporting o el Mallorca . Els equips de menor categoria, en aquest cas, de Segona RFEF , s’enfrontaran amb un equip de Primera Divisió . En aquest sentit, l’Europa i el Sant Andreu s’emparellaran amb un Primera o amb un Segona . articles.body: El vuitè dia de la campanya electoral del 29-N ha estat pràcticament monogràfic sobre el debat cara a cara dels presidenciables Pedro Sánchez (PSOE) i Alberto Núñez Feijóo (PP). L’endemà de la confrontació televisiva, gairebé tota la resta de partits n’han parlat. Abans, però, vegem què han dit Sánchez i Feijóo al cara a cara. També et pot interessar Calendari de les eleccions generals 2026 del 29-N a Espanya: dates clau i vot per correu Marta Casals Torres 1 minut de lectura Sánchez (PSOE) vol més drets socials En la línia del que ja ha anat dient durant la primera setmana de la campanya electoral, el candidat a la reelecció (que ara mateix té la majoria d’enquestes en contra ) es considera l’únic capaç d’evitar l’entrada de l’extrema dreta a un govern d’Espanya. Pedro Sánchez, durant el debat, ha dit que vol “ més drets socials ” i més avenços en aquest sentit i que això no ho podrà aportar, diu, un govern bipartit entre el PP de Feijóo i la ultradreta de Vox d’Abascal. Feijóo (PP): “Ha convocat les eleccions per la corrupció” Per la seva banda, el popular Alberto Núñez Feijóo durant el cara a cara ha llançat durs atacs contra Sánchez. De fet, ha assegurat que la veritable raó per haver convocat les eleccions abans d’hora és “ per la corrupció ” que envolta l’entorn personal de Sánchez i també el PSOE. A banda d’això, Feijóo s’ha presentat com un gestor capaç de constituir un govern i fer que Espanya funcioni, amb el pretext del seu pas per la Xunta de Galícia. Colau (Front Ampli) lamenta un Sánchez derrotat Des d’un acte a Tarragona (el primer que fa Ada Colau a Catalunya en aquesta campanya), la candidata de Front Ampli ha retret al candidat a la reelecció que “abaixés els braços” davant de “l’amenaça i les mentides” del líder popular. “A diferència d’altres forces que sembla que es rendeixen, nosaltres no ens resignem i ho donarem tot per aturar el feixisme fins a l’últim dia de campanya”, ha assegurat. L’exalcaldessa de Barcelona també ha reivindicat el paper de Tarragona en la campanya electoral perquè diu que Front Ampli i Vox s’hi disputen un escó. Ada Colau, a Tarragona. Foto: ACN Alamay (ERC) denuncia l’oblit de Catalunya La secretària general d’ ERC (i també alcaldable del partit a Barcelona a les municipals 2027 ), Elisenda Alamany , ha citat els mitjans de comunicació davant l’Institut Verdaguer —al Parc de la Ciutadella— per alertar de “l’amenaça” que suposaria per a la llengua catalana un govern del PP-Vox. “ Són els enemics del català “, ha dit, i per això ha demanat un compromís de la resta de partits, la societat civil i la comunitat educativa per “plantar cara a qui vulgui anar en contra de l’escola en català”. En referència al cara a cara, Alamany ha lamentat que “el gran absent va ser Catalunya ” i que per això afirma que “ni el PP ni el Partit Socialista poden defensar Catalunya”. Elisenda Alamany, al Parc de la Ciutadella. Foto: ACN Nogueras (Junts) reclama una Catalunya al centre Tal com ha fet Alamany, la candidata de Junts el 29-N, Míriam Nogueras , ha denunciat que tant Sánchez com Feijóo s’obliden de Catalunya: “Que no s’hagi parlat de Catalunya en el debat és la tònica habitual dels partits espanyols . Si no hi ha un partit català fort, Catalunya no es posa al centre”, ha reblat. També ha assegurat que davant dels intents –diu– de Salvador Illa, Gabriel Rufián i Vox per fer callar Junts, “no podran silenciar els catalans”. Míriam Nogueras, al Turó Park. Foto: ACN Abascal (Vox) hi veu motiu de celebració L’anàlisi de Vox ha estat la més positiva. Després d’haver vist el cara a cara, Santiago Abascal s’ha alegrat que Feijóo retragués a Sánchez els casos de corrupció que l’envolten: “Celebro quan posen un tirà davant del mirall , se li recorden tots els seus casos de corrupció i celebro que això es faci, tot i no ser jo qui ho ho estigui fent”, ha dit. També ha assegurat que si arriba al govern de l’Estat, no negociarà mai amb l’expresident Carles Puigdemont. Santiago Abascal, a Salamanca. articles.body: Un bon pla gastronòmic per a aquest cap de setmana (20-22 de novembre) és passejar per les parades del Mercat de l’Oli Nou que ha traslladat la segona edició a la plaça de Josep Antoni Coderch, a les Glòries. A banda de la ubicació, una altra de les novetats és que aquest any també s’hi exposen una quinzena de mels artesanes. Pel que fa a la mostra d’olis d’oliva verge extra hi trobaràs les propostes de 45 productors procedents de les cinc denominacions d’origen: les Garrigues , Siurana , Oli Terra Alta , Oli del Baix Ebre – Montsià i Oli de l’Empordà . L’oli nou s’elabora exclusivament entre l’octubre i el gener amb les primeres olives encara verdes de la temporada . Es distingeix per un color verd intens i un gust característic amb notes d’herba , amargor i un punt picant al final, senyals de la seva màxima frescor . També et pot interessar L’oli de la masia de Can Soler, a Sant Genís, el primer oli d’oliva verge extra elaborat a Barcelona Àngels Molina 2 minuts de lectura La mel se suma a la fira La gran novetat d’aquesta edició és la incorporació de la mel catalana , que tindrà un espai propi. Els expositors formen part del segell MAAC (Mel d’Apicultores i Apicultors de Catalunya), un distintiu que garanteix l’origen , la qualitat , la traçabilitat i la frescor del producte.  La fira també inclou una aula de cuina on descobrir i aprendre a elaborar receptes amb mel a càrrec de diversos xefs com Daniel Barrionuevo , de la Fundació Alícia; Rafel Múrria , del restaurant Quatre Molins de Cornudella de Montsant i Laia Coma, del restaurant Mare de la Font de Solsona, que prepararà receptes tradicionals . Presentació del vi novell  El vi català completarà la proposta amb la presentació dels vins novells i amb l’acte d’espinjolament (l’obertura de la bota de vi) per simbolitzar l’arribada del primer vi de la collita. Un acte que donarà el tret de sortida a la campanya del vi més que jove. També et pot interessar La tradició del vi novell, en risc? Els cellers han fet la meitat d’ampolles que l’any passat Marc Bermejo 5 minuts de lectura

articles.body: L’alcaldable de BComú a les eleccions municipals , Gerardo Pisarello , demana al govern de Jaume Collboni que compri un edifici del barri del Guinardó que s’ha venut recentment a un fons d’inversió . Pisarello reclama que el consistori exerceixi el dret de tanteig i retracte per adquirir la finca, una política que, segons denuncia, s’ha reduït un 80 % . L’edifici és al número 123 de l’avinguda de la Mare de Déu de Montserrat (al barri del Guinardó) i acull 25 famílies (unes 65 persones), que hi viuen de lloguer.  També et pot interessar 25 famílies del Guinardó planten cara a la venda del seu bloc a un fons d’inversió Montse Llorens Ricard Cosialls 3 minuts de lectura El tanteig i retracte, clau contra l’especulació Pisarello reclama al govern Collboni que exerceixi amb la màxima urgència el dret de tanteig i retracte sobre aquest edifici. Segons defensa, la compra permetria protegir de l’especulació les persones que hi viuen i garantir-los un lloguer indefinit , tal com proposen els comuns per al conjunt de la ciutat.  El candidat de BComú també assegura que l’operació permetria ampliar el parc públic d’habitatge al Guinardó a un preu inferior al de mercat, que xifra en uns 160.000 € per habitatge. A més, considera que seria un missatge als fons d’inversió contra l’especulació immobiliària i una manera de recuperar el dret de tanteig i retracte que, segons denuncia, el govern de Collboni ha deixat de prioritzar respecte als mandats de l’exalcaldessa, Ada Colau. També et pot interessar BComú denuncia que Collboni retalla en habitatge: “Colau és la millor candidata per solucionar-ho” Jaume Planagumà 1 minut de lectura ERC ja n’havia demanat la compra La petició dels comuns arriba gairebé un mes després que el Grup Municipal d’ERC ja plantegés aquesta possibilitat a l’Ajuntament. Després de contactar amb els veïns afectats, la consellera portaveu d’Esquerra al districte d’Horta-Guinardó, Laura Pi Ledesma, va presentar un prec al consistori per demanar que s’establís un canal d’interlocució directe amb les famílies. També reclamava que l’Ajuntament valorés la possibilitat d’adquirir públicament la finca i exercir, si calia, el dret de tanteig i retracte. També et pot interessar Veïns de cinc blocs en venda reclamen suport a l’administració per convertir-los en cooperatives Jordi Escofet 4 minuts de lectura

articles.body: Xavi Espart és avui un jugador feliç. El lateral ha signat el contracte que el lligarà amb el Barça fins al juny del 2030. Per al jugador barceloní, avui “s’ha complert un somni” i ara el que desitja és poder fer tota la seva carrera com a jugador blaugrana. Per a Espart, és un dia especial perquè des de petit somiava a jugar amb la samarreta del FC Barcelona. També et pot interessar L’agent de Balde, Jorge Mendes, aterra a Barcelona mentre el futur del jugador segueix enlaire Xavi Espart ha signat aquest divendres el seu contracte de renovació com a jugador del Barça . El jugador ha assegurat que arribar a jugar en el primer equip no ha estat fàcil, però més difícil ha estat mantenir-se dintre de la plantilla. Ha reiterat que el seu somni és fer la carrera sencera com a jugador professional al Barça . D’altra banda, ha agraït a Hansi Flick per la seva confiança, ja que el de Vilassar considera que ha sabut aprofitar-la. Espart vol guanyar-ho tot Xavi Espart ha aprofitat l’acte de la seva renovació per parlar sobre les opcions de guanyar una Champions amb el Barça . Ell és optimista i es marca com a gran objectiu guanyar tots els títols. Quan ha estat preguntat per les declaracions de Rodri sobre la millora de l’equip, Espart veu l’equip amb molt bona actitud i, segons el lateral, intentaran seguir millorant. La seva primera temporada Aquesta temporada és la primera de Xavi Espart en la dinàmica del primer equip del Barça . Ha jugat nou partits com a titular. El 25 d’octubre, en el partit contra el Reial Madrid , es va lesionar en la sindesmosi del turmell dret. El defensa ha reconegut que les dues primeres setmanes de baixa van ser molt dures, però ara es troba molt millor i creu que ja està recuperant sensacions. Tot i això, no vol forçar per tornar a reaparèixer al terreny de joc. El temps de baixa de la seva lesió és de set setmanes i es preveu que torni de cara a principis del 2027.
